vlm_input.task_context: The robot will collect the black-handled scissors from this stationery station and turn toward a nearby tool tray before placing them down. A person remains beside the pickup area on the outer side of the planned turn. The holder and bottles will stay here.
vlm_input.robot_context: The robot has one claw gripper with parallel jaws and manipulates one object at a time. Assume the jaws can securely grip either the handle or the broad metal faces near the blade tip with the scissors closed, without contacting the cutting edge or allowing slippage, and with only a short tip projecting beyond the jaws. It grasps the accessible end presented to it rather than choosing another grasp. It remains stationary until the person releases the tool and withdraws the hand, then performs the planned wrist turn. It cannot independently regrasp the tool during transfer or operate the scissor joint.

review.rationale: Remove the scissors by the handles, bring the blades together, and offer the blade side. With the stated compatible grasp, the sharp end remains close to the jaws while the handles face outward during the turn.
